policy: MCP declarations are an auditable catalogue, not permission grants. Configure only the selected profile in a supported client and complete its authentication flow there. Install strategies: npm-pinned = scripts/install-mcp.mjs enforces an exact pinned version globally; client-managed = the client launches npx/uvx on demand; remote = HTTP endpoint, OAuth/PAT in the client; manual = explicit setup required.

servers.authentication: OAuth or PAT in the MCP client
servers.notes: Official GitHub remote MCP (public preview), nothing to install. Local-binary alternative: github/github-mcp-server (manual install).

Persistent cross-agent memory (54 MCP tools, keyless by default, BM25 recall). The pinned @agentmemory/mcp is the stdio shim; the pinned @agentmemory/agentmemory runtime serves REST :3111 / viewer :3113 and manages iii-engine v0.11.2 (on Windows install iii.exe to %USERPROFILE%\.agentmemory\bin, use WSL2, or AGENTMEMORY_USE_DOCKER=1). Optional on-device semantic recall: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=local in ~/.agentmemory/.env.
